rawContent: My #WomensHistoryMonth/#BlackLivesMatter spotlight/of an amazing Black woman we should support: ALAINA SIMONE. An authority in America and globally on art, new and established visual artists, as well as gallery and museum consultation and curation. https://t.co/ELzubSdR1s

My #WomensHistoryMonth/#BlackLivesMatter spotlight of amazing Black woman we should support: MARITRI GARRETT. Since COVID-19 hit last year, MARITRI has been doing daily live gigs on her Facebook page, Maritri Garrett. M is a TERRIFIC singer/songwriter/pianist/guitarist/bassist. https://t.co/Do8zLYGrjy

My #WomensHistoryMonth/#BlackLivesMatter spotlight of amazing Black woman we should support: MYA @MYAPLANET9. Grammy-winning music artist, yes, but her holistic growth has been powerful. Brilliant businesswoman on her own terms, vegan, spiritual force for good. Check her resume. https://t.co/7eJ0lwF9x3

My #WomensHistoryMonth/#BlackLivesMatter spotlight of amazing Black women we should support: APRIL SILVER. She is founder of Akila Worksongs, which does all things communications. April coined the term "email blast" and her work selflessly touches community, politics, the arts. https://t.co/dSswsg3Ijq

My #WomensHistoryMonth/#BlackLivesMatter spotlight of amazing Black women we should support: JACQUETTE M. TIMMONS. One of the BEST financial/money management minds I have ever encountered in my life. Jacquette calls herself a “financial behaviorist” and looks at all life choices. https://t.co/WKR4sgVGFe

My #WomensHistoryMonth/#BlackLivesMatter spotlight of a Black woman we should never forget: BREONNA TAYLOR #BreonnaTaylor. TODAY, March 13, marks exactly one year since Breonna was killed during a sloppy and botched police raid of her Louisville, Kentucky home. #SayHerName https://t.co/u59uvOGK5o
